summary: check_plan and check_boot_copy of tools/dev/machine_grow.sh, through the case machine.grow.check of tests/cases/host/grow.sh on real seed file systems and a whole boot partition, with each check taken out of a private copy of the script

faults.name: ranges
faults.summary: a check_plan that does not compare the ranges with the geometry

edits.find: cmp "$work/ranges.txt" "$work/expected-ranges.txt" || fail 'ranges differ from the seed and target geometry'

lines: grow: result: failed: machine.grow.check: ranges-small plan-samsung ranges-samsung plan-samsung-gpt ranges-samsung-gpt boot-copy boot-corrupt

faults.name: boot
